items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Yeah, he could read. Well, like I'm telling you, he wasn't a first class reader, but he read.

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you the truth. I made them all favorites. You liked it, Mike. It's all good. Yeah, I tried to do everything well. You know, I liked it.
Yeah, he could read. Well, like I'm telling you, he wasn't a first class reader, but he read.
